answer: Delivery-commitment bond: each identity promises 10 timber units by epoch close for a 60 bond. Payment crosses a bridge only on client confirmation. A missed deadline burns the bond. Each fake needs a 60 bond plus 10 timber units at 5 each: 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 credits, zero return. Rented timber fails the prism check: each unit bears its maker's key, so one pledged twice burns both bonds. An honest agent locks 60 once, keeps its full share.
